'''Myri Antilles''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], was the second daughter of [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Iella Wessiri Antilles]].

==Biography==
===Childhood===
[[File:MyriAntilles.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Myri around age 22]]
An intelligent and stubborn girl, she was named for her father's childhood friend [[Mirax Terrik Horn]], whose nickname as a child was Myra. In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], after the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], she and her older sister [[Syal Antilles|Syal]] were sent to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|The Maw]] for safety along with mainly [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] children for the rest of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

===Later life===
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Myri was living with her family on [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. She inherited Iella's inquisitive nature and affinity for intelligence activities, and, as of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], was being groomed by her mother to follow in her footsteps as an intelligence agent.

After her graduation she was approached by both the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and [[Five Worlds]], she subsequently refused both offers deciding to do as her father had, and just stay out of the whole war, something that didn't happen as they were forced to blast their way off of Corellia when they noticed [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] being chased after by the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]]. They escaped to the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' where Myri worked for tips as a card dealer in one of the ''Venture's'' casinos with her mother to gather information. The sheer amount of money that she was making caused her to rethink about joining the intelligence business albeit halfheartedly. She also correctly deduced that whoever was behind the conflict was secretly trying to split the Solo-Skywalker "alliance."

Myri continued to gather intelligence during the course of the [[Second Galactic Civil War|war]] while on board the ''Errant Venture'' getting rich gambling in the process.

In [[44 ABY]], Myri was recruited to the reformed [[Wraith Squadron]] to expose and capture General [[Stavin Thaal]] as a member of the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]]. She contributed by disguising herself as a protocol droid, enabling her to get close to Thaal so she could swipe his blaster before he could kill his ex-wife [[Zehrinne Thaal|Zehrinne]] and Colonel [[Kadana Sorrel]] when he, in his new identity as Thadley Biolan, was exposed as an "impostor".

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|I'm&hellip;I'm a protégée of Booster Terrik. I was named for his daughter. I own six fleecing records on the ''Errant Venture''|Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
Myri Antilles was an accomplished gambler and as a result of her working in a gambling environment, she developed an ability to spot fake jewelry.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Myri_Antilles.jpg|thumb|right|170px|Myri playing with her food as a child.]]
Her role as a member of [[Wraith Squadron]] in [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' was reported by attendees of [[Wikipedia:Dragon Con|Dragon Con]] [[2011]] stating that the author had confirmed it.<ref name="Dragon Con">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31889052|board=Literature|thread=X-Wing: Mercy Kill - New Aaron Allston Wraith Squadron Novel (2012)|user=xoubara|date=2011-09-06|time=5:51 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802125528/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/x-wing-mercy-kill-new-aaron-allston-wraith-squadron-novel-2012.31173300/page-13}}</ref>

In ''Mercy Kill'' she is described as having natural black hair, despite being first shown with blonde hair in ''Union''.
